recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞偏多，除了成群的紅血球系前驅細胞外，可見體積小、核分葉不良的巨核細胞（hypolobated micromegakaryocyte，左下方）；小而少分葉的巨核細胞加上三系混雜，是 MDS 巨核細胞發育不良的切片線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces
Small megakaryocytes with hypolobated or monolobated round nuclei
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
No sheets of blasts; interstitial hemorrhage present
describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes include small forms with hypolobated, round nuclei, suggestive of dysmegakaryopoiesis. Erythroid precursors form clusters and granulocytic maturation is present. No sheets of blasts are identified. The findings are compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) shows numerous non-lobated/hypolobated megakaryocytes typically of normal to large size and requires cytogenetic confirmation; ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation favor MDS-RS.
MDS/MPN-RS-T has large, hyperlobated MPN-like megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis rather than small hypolobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobated and well dispersed without micromegakaryocytes.
